notes.title: Debut Festival Preview: 3 Cards from the Demo
notes.content:
[h2]3 Cards Revealed![/h2][p]We're so excited to be participating in our first ever festival, the Debut Festival! For all the newcomers, here's a look at 3 cards that you will be able to play in our upcoming demo.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691895/ca0df1eee83d3c09ce1dd3aade2c0491293ec3c8.png"][/img]
Before our public demo goes live, we’ll be inviting a small group of players to join an early beta and help us put the finishing touches. 

Make sure to wishlist the game so you don't miss the beta announcement or the demo drop! [/p][p]Also, join us on [url="https://discord.gg/dnSeQ3ENMQ"]Discord[/url], we'd love to hear from you directly!
[/p]
